dataset.title: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission (CBC and other assays)
dataset.citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-569, SpaceX Inspiration4 Whole Blood / Complete Blood Count data, doi:10.26030/e0rx-sh52. https://osdr.nasa.gov/bio/repo/data/studies/OSD-569
dataset.access_note: Publicly downloadable OSDR content. Follow current OSDR terms and acknowledgement requirements. This adapter does not assert a study-specific Creative Commons license.

limitations: Samples were taken before launch and after return; there are no in-flight samples.
These are retrospective laboratory measurements from four de-identified Inspiration4 crew members, not current telemetry or the user's medical data.
Laboratory reference intervals are displayed as source context only; they are not personalized baselines, mission limits, alerts, or diagnostic criteria.
Missing analytes are not imputed. Original source values are preserved.
A sample-level data-integrity check flags C003 at L-92. Its original values are preserved but should not be used for inference.
The research dataset is kept separate from ASTRA's synthetic telemetry analysis and alert engine.

quality_flags.reason: Sample-level data-integrity warning: absolute differential values do not reconcile with the reported differential percentages and white blood cell count (ABSOLUTE NEUTROPHILS, ABSOLUTE LYMPHOCYTES, ABSOLUTE MONOCYTES, ABSOLUTE EOSINOPHILS, ABSOLUTE BASOPHILS). Original NASA values are preserved and marked suspect.
